title: Umklami Wesifiso Samanga
intro: Umuntu owayenegunya elikhulu wake wakhonza omunye wababusi abadumile emlandweni eGibhithe lasendulo. Lo muntu waphathiswa umyalo onesibindi — wokwakha isakhiwo esenzelwe ukuphikisa amazulu. Indaba yabo isemi ku-Quran njengesifundo esiphawulekayo mayelana nokuthi ukulalela ngokungaboni ukuzikhukhumeza kuholela kanjani ekubhujisweni.
clues: Ngakhonza ezinkantolo zombusi onamandla owayethi unguNkulunkulu phezu kwamazwe.
Bengiphethe isikhundla esiphakeme sokuba ngungqongqoshe, ngiluleka umbusi oqhoshayo kakhulu wesikhathi sami.
Umbusi wami wayegcwele ukuphikisa uNkulunkulu kaMose, labo abenqaba ukumqaphela.
Ngayalwa ukuba ngakhe umbhoshongo wezitini ezishiswe ngomlilo ukuze umbusi wami akwazi ukukhuphukela ezulwini.
Umbhoshongo awuzange ufike esibhakabhakeni, futhi ukugqilazwa kwami ​​​​kokuzikhukhumeza kwangitholela ihlazo laphakade.
Ngabhubha kanye nalowo engangimlandela, futhi igama lami laba yisixwayiso esihlala njalo kulabo abavumela ababusi abangondlovukayiphikiswa.

trial.label: Isivivinyo/Umcimbi
options: Wayalwa ukuba akhe isakhiwo eside ukuze afinyelele ezulwini
Ucelwa ukuba achaze iphupho elithunyelwe livela kuNkulunkulu
Kuphoqelekile ukukhetha phakathi kwesihlalo sobukhosi neqiniso
trial.answer: Wayalwa ukuba akhe isakhiwo eside ukuze afinyelele ezulwini

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Ngahlangana kabusha nomndeni wami ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokudingiswa

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verse: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority (40:23)
